description: Found while proposing fz-sc8.14: max(3, 4) is error[lower/unbound] 'unresolved direct runtime callee max/2'. Only Enum.max/Enum.min exist (lib/enum.fz). Elixir's Kernel.max/2 and min/2 use term ordering across types (number < atom < reference < function < port < pid < tuple < map < list < bitstring) and are allowed in guards since 1.19? (verify before building). Write them over the existing term comparison (fz_value_cmp_ref / compare) in lib/kernel.fz, add them to the prelude, with oracle fixtures on interp, run and build.
title: Kernel.max/2 and Kernel.min/2 compare any two terms, as in Elixir
